assets.name: blue
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production 32-frame portal animation sprite sheet matching the supplied seven-frame BLUE-WHITE teleport-rift reference, not a poster. The reference contact sheet shows the same portal's motion over time. FRAME FORMAT: 256 x 256 pixels per frame, exactly FOUR columns and EIGHT rows = 1024 x 2048 sheet. Exactly 32 frames in chronological row-major order. Every cell has the same fixed aperture center at (128,128), same unchanging upright orientation, one common scale, and generous empty transparent margins. Do not move, tilt, resize, squash, shift or rotate the entire portal. At every frame its main elliptical opening remains precisely centered, outer mean envelope about118 pixels wide and200 pixels tall. Reference style: chunky detailed hand-painted arcade pixel energy, incandescent blue-white jagged rim, layered cobalt and indigo inner turbulence, deep near-black inner opening, soft pixel-cluster blue aura at the outside. Inner opening stays dark and opaque enough to read as a doorway to blackness, not a completely white filled blob. Native genuine transparency OUTSIDE the effect only. ANIMATION: 32 distinct successive drawn phases of a stable open rift: white-blue flame tongues crawl clockwise along the oval rim, three localized bright knots orbit and trade intensity, cobalt plasma rolls inside the hole. Small edge flares breathe within the reserved envelope. The energy travels and changes shape while the physical aperture stays fixed. Even smooth phase advance from frame1 to frame32; frame32 must lead smoothly into frame1 without copying it. NOT 8 poses repeated, not mirrored duplicates, not a sheet of progressively shrinking portals. Keep the ring complete in every frame and the same center, mean width and height in every cell. Preserve the old-school reference's coarse pixel texture rather than modern smooth neon vectors or glossy photorealism. No backdrop, painted checkerboard, environment, ground, border, labels, text, ships, characters, black rectangular matte or cast shadow. Return the complete full 4x8 sprite sheet with no cropping of any glow.

assets.name: void
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 32-frame BLACK VOID TUNNEL animation matching the supplied void-portal.gif contact sheet. Reference images show chronological motion of a deep navy/crimson/violet spiral around a stable pitch-black vanishing point. FRAME FORMAT: exactly4 columns by8 rows of equal256x256 cells, overall1024x2048,32 unique chronological frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom. OPAQUE BLACK background and opaque black center. Every frame's circular black aperture is centered EXACTLY at128,128 and has the SAME radius28pixels. No wandering center, camera motion, zooming, whole-image rotation, tilt, size changes or rolling camera. Keep the surrounding image an open shapeless void, no doors, structures or physical rim. Draw layered inky indigo and crimson-magenta smoke streaks spiraling inward through blackness, like a hand-painted 1990s arcade pixel vortex, using the reference's wispy brush-like pixel energy rather than smooth vector rings. Motion advances in32 small consistent steps: outer wisps sweep clockwise while inner tendrils spiral toward the same black hole; new ripples emerge behind the old. Changing drawn eddies and folds, not32 rotations of one still. Frame32 joins frame1 seamlessly,32 real unique stages, not8 recycled frames. Strongest color sits in the inner-middle spiral; outermost20pixels of EVERY cell fade to plain opaque black so each cell is separable with no seams when composited over black. The aperture is always a complete clean circle of uninterrupted pitch black at the fixed center, no white hotspot. Rich black/deepblue/purple/crimson palette, cinematic alien void depth, controlled pixel clusters. No text, labels, border, grid, checkerboard, interface, stars, characters or ships. Entire sheet consists solely of32 centered opaque square void frames on black.

assets.name: gate_frame
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the stationary modular DOOR FRAME for an animated purple arcade portal, based on the supplied portal.gif contact sheet. One isolated front-facing symmetrical black-obsidian arch with chunky block-shaped dark charcoal stones, subtle slate facets, and a small glowing violet diamond keystone at the top. Match the reference's classic bold pixel-art silhouette, upgrade texture to detailed Neo-Geo pixel clusters without changing the readable blocky shape. FRAME FORMAT:512 x640 pixels. The entire arch fits within x64..448,y48..592 with generous genuine transparent margins. Exactly centered upright with zero perspective. The arch has two straight vertical legs and a rounded upper opening; OPEN APERTURE centered on x256, extending approximately x160..352,y192..592. IMPORTANT: the space INSIDE the arch opening and OUTSIDE the stones must be completely transparent alpha. No purple energy fill yet: the animated energy will be a SEPARATE layer behind the stationary stones. The two feet end at the same y592. Keep a complete uncut top and both feet. A restrained violet edge light on stone facing the aperture is okay, but no loose sparks or haze. No animation sheet, only one modular stationary frame. No floor, no shadows, backdrop, labels, grid, text, characters, ships, checkerboard or UI. A clean authored stone gate frame with diamond keystone, truly transparent hole and exterior.

assets.name: gate_energy
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate the animated PURPLE ENERGY INTERIOR for the supplied classic arcade portal reference, as a separate modular layer with NO stone arch. The contact sheet is the style/motion reference: bold concentric amethyst/lilac/violet pixel bands continuously pulsing outward from a fixed central vanishing point. FRAME FORMAT: exactly32 unique chronological frames, FOUR columns EIGHT rows, equal256 x256 cells, overall1024 x2048. ONE common scale. Every frame: a tall upright doorway-shaped purple membrane, width100pixels height180pixels, rounded semicircular top and flat bottom. Occupies x78..178 and y38..218, all remaining area clean native transparent alpha. The central vortex/pulse source stays at EXACTLY128,128 in EVERY frame. Same outer doorway contour and footprint throughout, no size change, no tilt, no drifting, no frame-varying squish. 32 successive smooth drawn phases: four to six nested broad purple energy rings expand outward as new smaller rings appear from the center, fade naturally into the violet membrane at the outside; little pale lavender highlight waves circulate through them. Rings are irregular concentric pixel clusters, not mathematically perfect vector circles. Match the reference's purple diamond/magenta/violet/lilac palette and deliberately chunky arcade pixel style, with a richer range of pixel-cluster highlights for HD arcade use. Inner medium/deep-purple source never moves. The background of the door membrane is saturated dark violet and opaque, its exterior genuine alpha. The loop from32 to1 is smooth, no duplicate or mirrored frames, no open/shrink/close sequence. NO arch, stones, gem, structures, objects, spark cloud, background, cast shadow, ground, checkerboard, frame labels, numbers or text. Keep exact4x8 grid and generous transparent gutters; every entire membrane cleanly isolated.
